Why LuxRun

The best way to know a city is to run through it.

LuxRun was born from a simple idea: what if running could be the best way to discover a city? Not a bus. Not a walking tour. Moving at pace, breathing the air, with stories flowing through your earphones.

Every tour mixes physical activity, curated audio storytelling, and the energy of people sharing something real. You arrive as a stranger. You leave knowing a city and a few new faces.

🎧

Audio storytelling

Professional audio at every landmark. History, culture, curiosities while you run.

👥

Real connections

Small groups. Most people join alone and leave with new friends.

How it works

From booking to finish line.

01

Book your spot

Choose a tour and pick a date from the calendar. Pay securely online. Max 12 people per run.

You will receive a confirmation email with all the details.

02

Download the app

Before the tour day, you will receive a personal QR code by email. Download the app and scan it to load your tour.

Important: download and set up the app before arriving. Once loaded, it works fully offline via GPS. No internet needed during the run.

03

Show up ready

Meet at the start point 5 minutes early. Bring earphones, running shoes, and curiosity.

The guide will be there. Look for the LuxRun sign.

04

Run and discover

The audio plays automatically as you move. The pace adapts to the group.

Around 1 hour total experience including warm-up, 6km run, and post-run kit at the finish.

Luxembourg City Running Tour

Four chapters.
One unforgettable city.

Block 01

The Modern City

Where Luxembourg's ambition meets European power. Kirchberg, the EU quarter, architecture that dares.

Block 02

Into the Old Town

Cobbled streets, hidden squares, and the social heart of the city.

Block 03

The Heart of the City

The Corniche, the Royal Palace, the valley below. The most beautiful views Luxembourg has to offer.

Block 04

Memory and Faith

Where the city remembers who it is. A finish that feels like an arrival, not just an end.

Start point

Coque Sports Centre

Kirchberg, Luxembourg City. Arrive 5 minutes early. Look for the LuxRun guide.

Finish point

Place de la Constitution

One of Luxembourg's most iconic viewpoints, overlooking the Petrusse valley.

Come prepared

What to bring.

👟

Running shoes

Comfortable trainers for running on pavements and cobblestones.

🎧

Earphones

Essential for the audio experience. Need a pair? Rent them at booking.

📱

Charged phone

Needed for the app. Set it up before arriving, not on the day.

🧥

Visible clothing

Wear bright or reflective sportswear, especially for morning runs.

🔦

Headlamp

Recommended in autumn and winter when it is still dark in the morning.

💧

Water (optional)

A bottle is handy but not required. We take care of the post-run kit at the finish.
